item.text:
`test/orders.js` exports simple order helpers: `calcTotal` sums item `price * qty`, `applyDiscount` applies `SAVE10`/`SAVE20`, `averageItemPrice` divides the total by item count, and `formatOrder` renders line items plus a formatted discounted total.

Bugs I see:

- [test/orders.js:5](C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-cjlPAQ/test/orders.js:5): `calcTotal` uses `i <= items.length`, so the loop reads `items[items.length]`, which is `undefined`. That makes [line 6](C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-cjlPAQ/test/orders.js:6) throw when accessing `.price`. It should be `i < items.length`.
- [test/orders.js:18](C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-cjlPAQ/test/orders.js:18): `averageItemPrice([])` would divide by zero, returning `NaN` once `calcTotal` is fixed. It should define behavior for empty orders, commonly `0` or an error.
- Because `formatOrder` calls `calcTotal`, [test/orders.js:25](C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-cjlPAQ/test/orders.js:25) currently fails for any non-empty order due to the same off-by-one loop bug.
